Vizzbox

FM-1-transporter

M-VAVE Downloads


  

  

  
The Vizzbox is a modified version of Skiff 2.0.1: Vizz 2.0 (SEQ MIDI OUT: the sequencer on USB MIDI, its mutes as CC 103) and a producer that makes the music itself (its sections as CC 104 .. 109); not a release of Skiff.

    Skiff by illuminus5, built on Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (@kurogedelic), Hügelton Instruments, with its CrispyZebra waveforms, drum voices, Sample Pack and Fukiai icons (MIT).

    SMK-37 support after genkigenki's SMK-37 layer (GPL-3.0). Font: Barlow Condensed (The Barlow Project Authors, SIL OFL 1.1). DRUM-X: JIANT FM by juanjiant-bit (GPL-3.0). Samples: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL (CC0 1.0).

    FM6 engine: msfa from Dexed (Google Inc., Pascal Gauthier, Apache-2.0). The package also holds three JieLi AC79 SDK files, uboot.boot, cfg_tool.bin and eq_cfg_hw.bin (JieLi Technology, Apache-2.0). Licences: GPL-3.0, Apache-2.0, all.

    M-VAVE, FM-1 and SMK-37 are trademarks of their respective owners.
